summary.key_theme: 受惠於 AI 資料中心對 Scorpio 產品的強勁需求，公司營收年增率達 104 %，展現強勁成長動能。

bullish.title: Astera Labs Has Found Its Next Growth Engine — Astera Labs Q2 revenue is +104% YoY; Q3 guide signals ~40% growth as Scorpio ramps.
bullish.reason: Q2 營收年增 104 %，且 Q3 指引預期成長約 40 %，顯示 Scorpio 產品線已成為核心成長引擎，基本面極為強勁。

bullish.title: Astera Labs: Massive AI Growth Is Still Underpriced — Astera Labs posts record Q2 results on surging AI data center demand.
bullish.reason: 強調 AI 資料中心需求激增帶動創紀錄財報，且認為股價回調後具備投資價值，具備估值修復潛力。

bullish.title: ALAB Rides on Strong Scorpio Demand: Can It Outpace MRVL and CRDO?
bullish.reason: 分析指出 ALAB 在 Scorpio 需求帶動下，具備超越同業 Marvell (MRVL) 與 Credo (CRDO) 的潛力，市場競爭力提升。

bullish.title: Alger Mid Cap 40 ETF Q2 2026 Portfolio Review — Astera Labs, Nebius Group, and Western Digital Corporation were among the top contributors to performance.
bullish.reason: 被納入 Alger Mid Cap 40 ETF 的績效貢獻前幾名，顯示機構投資人對其成長性的認可。

bullish.title: Astera Labs Stock And 2 AI Data Center Picks From Founder Led Companies
bullish.reason: 將 ALAB 列為創辦人領導的 AI 資料中心優質標的，長期治理結構與願景受到市場關注。

bearish.title: Astera Labs (ALAB) Stock May Trade At A Premium Following Its 61% Run
bearish.reason: 股價在短時間內上漲 61 %，分析師提醒目前估值可能已偏高，存在獲利回吐的修正風險。

neutral.title: Is Astera Labs, Inc. (ALAB) Stock Outpacing Its Computer and Technology Peers This Year?
neutral.reason: 僅針對今年股價表現與同業進行量化對比，未提供具體基本面預測，屬中性市場觀察。

neutral.title: Should Stronger Analyst Focus On Earnings Power In Astera Labs’ AI Story (ALAB) Require Action From Investors?
